detail: unguarded: rdflib names an internal identifier; holosdb and pyoxigraph leave the message unbound; COALESCE: rdflib still names the identifier, the other two say '[a blank node]'; IF(isBlank(...)): all three say '[a blank node]'

steps.stdout:
== unguarded STR(?e)
   rdflib      ['A label on n17bf63573341421096191661a2b82ba7b1 has no language tag.']
   holosdb     ['(unbound)']
   pyoxigraph  ['(unbound)']
== COALESCE(STR(?e), ...)
   rdflib      ['A label on n7e4afd9ee4f04de3af9f8923ff088bbdb1 has no language tag.']
   holosdb     ['A label on [a blank node] has no language tag.']
   pyoxigraph  ['A label on [a blank node] has no language tag.']
== guarded IF(isBlank(?e), ...)
   rdflib      ['A label on [a blank node] has no language tag.']
   holosdb     ['A label on [a blank node] has no language tag.']
   pyoxigraph  ['A label on [a blank node] has no language tag.']
